name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=chapter, descriptor=16_init). The '16' is a chapter ID (valid range 01-30, chapter 16 = 冰原之戰), a meaningful game-domain ID that must be preserved, NOT a Ghidra address residue. No address-derived suffix present. Name accurately reflects purpose (chapter 16 init handler).
purpose: Chapter 16 (冰原之戰) battle-init handler; dispatched from the per-chapter init handler table. In the binary it is a pure thunk (PUSH 0x28; JMP 0x33470) into fd2_chapter_13_init+5, so it runs the identical minimal init body.
logic_summary: Re-inits battle state, plays a single dialog page (page 0) of the current chapter text, and pans the camera to char 0. No cutscene, no portrait load, no per-unit char init, no camera-pan-and-window prelude, no battle_anim_phase reset, no clear-facing -- chapter 16 carries the party over from the previous chapter. Physically a 10-byte thunk: PUSH 0x28 (frame-size arg consumed by the shared CALL __CHK at 0x33470) then JMP 0x33470 (= fd2_chapter_13_init + 5), sharing the entire chapter-13 tail which itself tail-JMPs through the chapters-06/10/13/14 page-0 dialog chain (0x3344D -> 0x33206 -> 0x33140). The straight-line C is the functionally-equivalent Layer-2 reconstruction, byte-for-byte identical body to fd2_chapter_13_init.

returns.semantics: No return value. Pure side-effect handler (battle-state init + dialog scene + camera pan).
